messages.subject: summary function from semTools returns error
parts:
Hi all

I am trying to get the results of my sem model which uses a dataset that is multiple imputed. I have had no success with this. when I declare `fit.measures = TRUE` in the summary function, I get the below error. Does anybody have a solution for this? 

I have downloaded the latest versions of lavaan and semTools, despite this, the issue still persists. See below for a reproducible code and sessioninfo.
 
Error in .local(object, ...) : unused argument (fit.measures = TRUE)

# download pacman package if not installed, otherwise load it
if(!require(pacman)) install.packages(pacman)

# loads relevant packages using the pacman package
pacman::p_load(
  dplyr,
  semTools,
  lavaan,
  mice )      

# make 10 dataset using mice

boys_imp <- boys %>%
  mice(.,
       m = 3,
       cluster.seed = 1234)

# set up model
fit <-  "sem =~ age + bmi + hc + hgt + wgt"

# run model
model_fit <- semTools::cfa.mi(fit,
                              fun = "sem",
                              miPackage = "mice",
                              parallel = "snow",
                              ncpus = 7,
                              seed = 9862,
                              estimator = "MLM",
                              std.lv = TRUE,
                              data = boys_imp)

# summarise model
summary(model_fit,
        test = "D2",
        pool.robust = TRUE,
        ci = TRUE,
        fit.measures = TRUE,
        standardized = TRUE
)

On Wednesday, March 16, 2022 at 1:47:28 PM UTC+1 christia...hhl.de wrote:
Whatever the reason, when I run your code I get this with no error message:

Did you run it in R, or RStudio?   I could also run it fine in R, but I got the same error as the OP when using RStudio.  So I re-installed (the same CRAN version of) semTools, then ran this syntax (without any tidyverse nonsense) in a fresh R session:

library(mice)
boys_imp <- mice(boys, m = 3, cluster.seed = 1234)
## save imputations in a list of data.frames, rather than pass a mids object to cfa.mi
impList <- list() 
for (i in 1:boys_imp$m) impList[[i]] <- complete(boys_imp, action = i) 

library(semTools)
mod <- "f =~ age + bmi + hc + hgt + wgt"
model_fit <- cfa.mi(mod, data = impList, seed = 9862,
                    parallel = "snow", ncpus = 7, # why 7, when you have 3 imputations?
                    estimator = "MLM", std.lv = TRUE)
summary(model_fit, test = "D2", pool.robust = TRUE, #ci = TRUE, # already the default
        fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = "std.all")
# see class?lavaan.mi for argument descriptions
# perhaps better to simply call fitMeasures() directly

It worked fine after updating.  Perhaps something to do with the 2 non-base packages that RStudio loads:
loaded via a namespace (and not attached):

[1] compiler_4.1.3 tools_4.1.3
